def factor_nonlinear_volume_price_coordination(df):
    """Nonlinear signed power of rolling correlation between return and volume change."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    vol_chg = df_copy['volume'].pct_change()
    corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(vol_chg)
    signal = np.sign(corr) * np.power(np.abs(corr), 1.5)
    signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy['factor_nonlinear_volume_price_coordination'] = signal
    return df_copy['factor_nonlinear_volume_price_coordination']
